info.name: Fuel Route API Assessment
info.description: Health and US fuel-route planning requests. Set base_url if your local server uses another port.

exec: pm.test('Healthy and fuel data imported', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().fuel_station_count).to.be.above(0); });

pm.test('Route, map, and cost returned', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.distance_miles).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(data.map_geojson.type).to.eql('FeatureCollection'); pm.expect(data.fuel_stops).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(data.total_money_spent_on_fuel_usd).to.be.a('string'); });

item.name: Los Angeles to New York (multiple stops)

exec: pm.test('Long route has multiple fuel purchases', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().fuel_stops.length).to.be.above(1); });
